newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Electricity Corp of NZ to upgrade Waitaki station.
newsitem.headline: Electricity Corp of NZ to upgrade Waitaki station.

text.p: State-owned power generator Electricity Corp of New Zealand said on Thursday it planned to spend NZ$6.0 million to increase Waitaki hydro power generation.
The upgrade of Aviemore power station would allow extra generation for 6,400 households, without using more water, ECNZ said.
ECNZ said it signed the contract today with Toshiba International Corporation, the company responsible for designing and manufacturing the new equipment.
The installation would start in early 1999, with completion due in April 2000.
Work at Aviemore would be carried out in parallel with the Waitaki power scheme automation.
